subject.title: chore(deps-dev): bump the development-minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Should ClawHub accept the Socket obfuscated-code alerts in the updated Vite/React Email dependency graph, split those updates out, or reject this grouped dependency bump?
rationale: The alerts concern third-party package contents and dependency paths, so automation cannot decide the repository’s supply-chain risk boundary.

options.title: Split risky dependency paths
options.body: Separate the Vite and React Email updates with Socket alerts from the rest of the grouped dev-dependency bump so each risk can be reviewed independently.

options.title: Accept alerts and repair formatting
options.body: A maintainer/security owner accepts the Socket alerts for this PR, then the branch includes the oxfmt 0.58 formatting output and reruns the required gates.

options.title: Reject grouped bump
options.body: Close or decline this grouped update if the obfuscated-code dependency alerts are not acceptable for ClawHub’s supply-chain policy.

recommendation.title: Split risky dependency paths
recommendation.body: Separate the Vite and React Email updates with Socket alerts from the rest of the grouped dev-dependency bump so each risk can be reviewed independently.

likelyOwner.reason: Current manifest blame and recent package-manifest history make this the best available human routing candidate for dependency/tooling decisions.
